title: Medtrum patch pump alarms cannot be acknowledged
symptom: When using the Medtrum PDM, if a pump alarm occurs, the alarm must be acknowledged in the PDM within 10 minutes, otherwise the patch will sound a siren until acknowledged. AAPS currently lacks the ability to acknowledge these alarms, so when the reservoir is empty, a siren sound is emitted that the user cannot stop in AAPS. The alarm can only be stopped by removing the patch and disconnecting the pump base.
evidence_quote: AAPS currently lacks the ability to acknowledge these alarms. This means, for example, that when the reservoir is empty, a siren sound is emitted that the user cannot stop in AAPS.
